items.title: Stoke Therapeutics (STOK) Stock Looks Pricey Following Fresh Dravet Data
items.summary: Stoke Therapeutics has seen a very strong run in its share price in recent years, which naturally puts the spotlight on whether that move still lines up with what its balance sheet can support. With the stock now reflecting years of optimism around its Dravet syndrome program, investors are starting to ask how comfortably the current valuation sits against the company’s book value. items.title: What Could Biogen (BIIB) Gain From Its New Protein Degrader Research Deal?
items.summary: Biogen (NasdaqGS:BIIB) said it has entered a research collaboration with TRIMTECH Therapeutics to develop small molecule protein degraders for neurodegenerative diseases. The agreement focuses on discovering targeted degraders that aim to remove disease related proteins in conditions such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s. items.title: Biogen (BIIB) Posts Positive Two Year Diranersen Results And Five Year Lecanemab Data
items.summary: Biogen (NasdaqGS:BIIB) reported positive two year Phase 2 CELIA results for diranersen in early Alzheimer’s disease. The firm released new five year data for lecanemab that showed sustained clinical benefit and reduced progression risk in treated patients. Management framed these late stage Alzheimer’s updates as key milestones for the company’s neurology pipeline.
